parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: protocol name
parameters.explanation: Name of the protocol to be configured

set protocols isis level 1 wide-metrics-.explanation: 配置ISIS协议级别1仅使用宽度量。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols mpls interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用MPLS协议。

set protocols ldp interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Configure LDP protocol on a specific interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to enable LDP protocol on

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 10.10.3.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols isis interface lo0.0 passi.command: set protocols isis interface lo0.0 passive
set protocols isis interface lo0.0 passi.explanation: Configures the specified interface as passive in the IS-IS protocol, meaning it will not send or receive IS-IS packets but will still be included in the IS-IS topology.

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured as passive in the IS-IS protocol.
